Name: Tilesheetinator - Tiled Tilesheet Linker Extension for Stardew
Author: irocendar
Description:
[size=5][b]Tilesheetinator - Stardew Tilesheet Extension for Tiled[/b][/size]

Create Stardew Valley maps that work in-game without having to copy vanilla and modded tilesheets back-and-forth, rename files with a [font=Courier New].[/font] in front of their name, edit maps only in the unpacked content folder or make symlink workarounds.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Open the preferences menu in Tiled:

[b]Windows, Linux:[/b] [font=Courier New]Edit[/font] > [font=Courier New]Preferences[/font]
[b]Mac:[/b] [font=Courier New]Tiled[/font] > [font=Courier New]Preferences[/font]

And select [font=Courier New]Plugins[/font] > [font=Courier New]Open ...[/font] . Save the extension inside the folder that opens.

Restart Tiled and check that the extension is now enabled by opening a map and making sure that there are now new options at the bottom of the [font=Courier New]Map[/font] menu.

[size=4][b]Instructions[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]Set Vanilla Maps Folder[/b][/size]
Click [font=Courier New]Ctrl+Shift+.[/font] or [font=Courier New]Map[/font] > [font=Courier New]Choose Unpacked Maps Folder[/font]. Once you set it, it will be saved in a config file in the same folder as the extension, so you only have to set it again if you need to move it or you deleted the config file.

[size=3][b]Fix Missing Tilesheets[/b][/size]
Click [font=Courier New]Ctrl+.[/font] or [font=Courier New]Map[/font] > [font=Courier New]Fix Stardew Tilesheets[/font] to load missing tilesheets in. This won't affect the map permanently so it's perfectly safe to save after doing this.

If tilesheets using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30001]Arbitrary Tilesheet Access[/url] syntax are found, you will be given the option to update them to [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/blob/develop/docs/release-notes.md#440]SMAPI 4.4.0's new built-in relative tilesheet source path support[/url].

[size=3][b]Add Vanilla Tilesheet[/b][/size]
Click [font=Courier New]Ctrl+,[/font] or [font=Courier New]Map[/font] > [font=Courier New]Add Vanilla Stardew Tilesheet[/font] to correctly add a new vanilla tilesheet manually. Remember that manually adding tilesheets will add them without any animations/preconfigured tile properties.

[size=3][b]Manage Tilesheet Mods[/b][/size]
Click [font=Courier New]Ctrl+Shift+,[/font] or [font=Courier New]Map[/font] > [font=Courier New]Manage Stardew Tilesheet Mods[/font] to open the tilesheet mod menu.

Add the folder _the actual tilesheet images are directly in_ using the browse button. If a mod has multiple recolour versions in separate folders, add whichever one you would like to see when editing the map.

Click the right arrow button next to any mod's line to add a tilesheet from that mod to the current map.

[b]Advanced:[/b]
If the asset names a mod uses have a prefix before the actual file name (like [font=Courier New]Prefix<filename>[/font], [font=Courier New]Prefix/<filename>[/font], or [font=Courier New]Prefix_<filename>[/font]), add that prefix to the prefix textbox.

For example, if a tilesheet mod has files [font=Courier New]tilesheet1.png[/font] and [font=Courier New]tilesheet2.png[/font] and loads them to [font=Courier New]Maps/ModId/tilesheet1[/font] and [font=Courier New]Maps/ModId/tilesheet2[/font], put [font=Courier New]ModId/[/font] in the prefix box.

[size=4][b]Where To Get Help[/b][/size]

For help with this extension, go to the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Stardew Valley discord server[/url]'s [font=Courier New]#making-mods-general[/font] channel or this mod page's posts tab.

You can report bugs via issues in the [url=https://github.com/irocendar/Tilesheetinator]Tilesheetinator GitHub repo[/url] but I recommend also letting me know via discord if you do.
